title: The Impostor is Among Us: Can Large Language Models Capture the Complexity of Human Personas?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating AI-generated versus human-crafted personas through user surveys, asking participants to rate the perceived stereotypicality of the personas on a 7-point Likert scale, supplemented by qualitative thematic analysis of free-text responses to identify occupational, age-related, and demographic stereotypes.
